purpose: Gate3DGen paired-data synthesis: generate a realistic clean scene and one controlled degradation for 3D-condition restoration training

scene_shadow_window.description: A natural indoor room near a large window, with a matte wooden or neutral support and a pale wall.
scene_shadow_window.gt_lighting: broad, even, neutral illumination on the visible object surface with no attached shadow
scene_shadow_window.camera_context: static eye-level camera, medium close-up, complete object visible
negative: no attached shadow on the object

scene_glass_display.description: A natural shop, cabinet or museum display photographed through a clean foreground glass pane.
scene_glass_display.gt_lighting: even neutral illumination on the object through clean glass with no reflection
scene_glass_display.camera_context: static frontal camera, level glass plane, complete object visible

scene_bright_window.description: A natural kitchen, office or room near a bright window, with surrounding architecture visible.
scene_bright_window.gt_lighting: normal unclipped neutral exposure on the object despite the bright surroundings
scene_bright_window.camera_context: static handheld-camera viewpoint, natural perspective, complete object visible

scene_dim_room.description: A natural dim room, hallway or workshop at dusk with a weak practical light and visible depth.
scene_dim_room.gt_lighting: even recoverable neutral illumination on the object with no crushed detail
scene_dim_room.camera_context: static handheld-camera viewpoint, normal perspective, complete object visible

scene_warm_indoor.description: A natural lived-in interior with warm practical lamps, textured walls and a neutral support.
scene_warm_indoor.gt_lighting: uniform neutral white-balanced illumination on the object
scene_warm_indoor.camera_context: static camera, realistic indoor photograph, complete object visible
negative: no warm or cool cast on the object

scene_depth_corridor.description: A natural corridor, workshop or covered walkway with strong receding lines and visible depth planes.
scene_depth_corridor.gt_lighting: even neutral illumination and normal sharpness across the object
scene_depth_corridor.camera_context: static camera, clear subject focus, natural depth separation, complete object visible

scene_motion_street.description: A natural street-side work area or station corridor with directional lines and distant urban detail.
scene_motion_street.gt_lighting: even neutral illumination and sharp static capture on the object
scene_motion_street.camera_context: static camera, sharp reference capture, complete object visible

scene_color_environment.description: A natural interior or storefront with a visible or off-frame colored practical light, illuminated sign, or colored surface that can plausibly cast colored light into the scene.
scene_color_environment.gt_lighting: uniform neutral illumination on the object with no environmental color spill
background_elements: colored practical light or illuminated sign
scene_color_environment.camera_context: static camera, realistic photographic perspective, complete object visible
negative: no color cast on the object

scene_handheld_detail.description: A natural mobile-camera photograph in a lived-in room or work area with visible environmental context.
scene_handheld_detail.gt_lighting: even neutral illumination with normal sharpness and exposure
scene_handheld_detail.camera_context: static reference framing, realistic mobile-camera perspective, complete object visible

scene_glare_source.description: A natural interior or architectural scene with a bright off-axis window or lamp and visible structure.
scene_glare_source.gt_lighting: normal contrast and exposure with no veiling glare on the object
scene_glare_source.camera_context: static camera, normal contrast reference capture, complete object visible

scene_rainy_glass.description: A natural rainy window or storefront scene with a clean foreground glass pane and distant outdoor detail.
scene_rainy_glass.gt_lighting: even neutral illumination through clean glass
scene_rainy_glass.camera_context: static camera, level glass plane, natural depth, complete object visible

crop.description_zh: 程序化平移画布，使主体部分越出边界。

variants.scene_rationale: The framing is a handheld or documentary capture in a real environment; the crop reflects an imperfect composition while the support and background remain visible.
variants.gt_prompt: Create the exact same object as a clean reference photograph in the specified scene.
variants.degradation_prompt: Move the framing so part of the object extends outside the {side} image boundary.

shadow.description_zh: 只改变物体表面的非均匀照明或附着阴影，不混入欠曝。

variants.scene_rationale: A directional light creates attached self-shadowing and uneven illumination across the object surface. The shadow remains confined to the object and does not affect the background or support.
variants.gt_prompt: Create the exact same object as a clean reference photograph in the specified scene.
variants.degradation_prompt: Create strong uneven directional lighting across the object surface. Add deep attached self-shadowing in the recessed, side-facing and occluded areas, with a clear light-to-dark gradient and natural edge transitions. Keep the object geometry, material and intrinsic color unchanged. Do not add shadows to the background, floor, wall or support.

glass_reflection.description_zh: 隔着玻璃拍摄时玻璃平面上的环境反射，不改变物体材质。

variants.scene_rationale: The pane, frame, and environment provide a physical optical reason for the reflection.
variants.gt_prompt: Create the exact same object as a clean reference photograph in the specified scene.
variants.degradation_prompt: Add a strong, clearly visible reflection of {reflection_content} on the foreground glass, partially obscuring the object.

reflection_content: a brick or concrete building facade
a window frame with indoor lamps
shelves and furniture from the room

veiling_glare.description_zh: 镜头或玻璃散射形成的眩光与局部对比度下降，不包含过曝。

variants.scene_rationale: A real architectural, indoor, or outdoor environment supplies the off-axis light, colored surface, or glass medium needed for this effect.
variants.gt_prompt: Create the exact same object as a clean reference photograph in the specified scene.
variants.degradation_prompt: Add strong veiling glare from a bright off-axis light, creating a broad milky veil and noticeable loss of contrast.

overexposure.description_zh: 程序化曝光增益和高光截断，与反射和眩光分离。

variants.scene_rationale: Strong window backlight or a bright outdoor opening explains highlight clipping.
variants.gt_prompt: Create the exact same object as a clean reference photograph in the specified scene.
variants.degradation_prompt: Apply strong global overexposure with bright object regions clipped.

optical_blur.description_zh: 程序化镜头失焦模糊，不混入降采样或压缩。

variants.scene_rationale: A shallow-depth documentary capture with focus locked near the object explains defocus.
variants.gt_prompt: Create the exact same object as a clean reference photograph in the specified scene.

digital_degradation.description_zh: 固定的降采样、传感器噪声与 JPEG 压缩流水线。

variants.scene_rationale: A low-light handheld/mobile capture explains moderate sensor noise and pipeline softness.
variants.gt_prompt: Create the exact same object as a clean reference photograph in the specified scene.
variants.degradation_prompt: Apply strong compression and sensor-processing artifacts without optical blur.

white_balance.description_zh: 程序化全局白平衡或颜色偏移，用于测试 albedo 颜色恢复。

variants.scene_rationale: The warm/cool environmental light source explains the color cast.
variants.gt_prompt: Create the exact same object as a clean reference photograph in the specified scene.
variants.degradation_prompt: Shift the global white balance strongly cool.

underexposure.description_zh: 程序化欠曝、黑位压缩和暗部噪声，与阴影分离。

variants.scene_rationale: A dim interior or night capture with one weak practical light explains shadow loss.
variants.gt_prompt: Create the exact same object as a clean reference photograph in the specified scene.
variants.degradation_prompt: Apply strong global underexposure with substantial but recoverable shadow clipping.

motion_blur.description_zh: 程序化方向性相机运动模糊，与高斯失焦分离。

variants.scene_rationale: Handheld panning, a moving subject, or nearby traffic explains directional motion blur.
variants.gt_prompt: Create the exact same object as a clean reference photograph in the specified scene.
variants.degradation_prompt: Apply strong directional motion blur from camera panning, object movement or nearby traffic, with the background streak direction consistent with the same motion.

local_color_spill.description_zh: 局部环境光颜色污染，不改变 intrinsic albedo。

variants.scene_rationale: A real architectural, indoor, or outdoor environment supplies the off-axis light, colored surface, or glass medium needed for this effect.
variants.gt_prompt: Create the exact same object as a clean reference photograph in the specified scene.
variants.degradation_prompt: Add a strong localized colored-light spill from a plausible nearby source, with a smooth falloff, soft edge, contact shadow and restrained highlight. It must look like captured illumination, not painted color or changed albedo.

dirty_glass.description_zh: 隔着有污渍、雾气、水滴或划痕的玻璃拍摄。

variants.scene_rationale: The requested edit is confined to the foreground glass plane.
variants.gt_prompt: Create the exact same object as a clean reference photograph in the specified scene.
variants.degradation_prompt: Make the image look photographed through heavily dirty glass with condensation haze, water droplets and fine scratches in the foreground.

combination_prompts.scene_rationale: A storefront, cabinet, or indoor window explains the glass plane, reflections, and layered background.
combination_prompts.gt_prompt: Create the exact same object as a clean reference photograph in the specified scene.
combination_prompts.degradation_prompt: Generate a foreground glass pane with a visible frame and add a clear environmental reflection on the glass.

combination_prompts.scene_rationale: A normal handheld indoor or storefront capture explains the support, soft light, glass reflection, and moderate digital softness.
combination_prompts.gt_prompt: Create the exact same object as a clean reference photograph in the specified scene.
combination_prompts.degradation_prompt: Generate a foreground glass pane with a visible edge or frame and add a strong environmental reflection that partially obscures the object.

sampling_recommendation.instruction: Generate GT from gt_prompt first, then generate degraded from that GT using degradation_prompt. Record both prompts, inputs, outputs, postprocess, scene_rationale, sampled placeholders and masks.

global_degradation_suffix: Use the GT scene unchanged. Preserve object geometry, camera, framing, support, background and unaffected pixels. Add only the specified degradation.
